notes:
Top-line: building JetBrains (IntelliJ/PyCharm) plugin for enterprise teams — want a local-index-first copilot.

What they said: 'We need completions that feel native to IntelliJ — <30ms for local index hits, graceful fallback to hosted model when index misses or for larger context.'

Technical requirements (summary):
- Plugin must ship with local indexing that lives in the developer's workspace (index persistence policy controlled by org).
- Low-latency streaming via gRPC/websocket from plugin to a local agent or VPC endpoint; prefer TLS with mutual auth.
- Model/version pinning: ability to pin plugin to a specific quantized model for deterministic completions across the org.
- Prefers on-prem or VPC private deployment due to IP concerns; need KMS per-tenant and audit logs retained 1y.
- Wants recommendations for quantized variants (4-bit/8-bit) + throughput guidance for developers running small GPU instances on-prem.

Business context: KiteBridge sells an IDE plugin (commercial) to mid-market engineering orgs building proprietary code. Their revenue model is per-seat + enterprise support. Redwood is attractive because of private deployment + routing/fallback controls.

Quotes from buyer: 'If you can give us a predictable latency profile and let our customers lock a model version, we can white-label quickly.'

POC acceptance criteria (from Diego/KiteBridge eng):
- Local index lookup end-to-end <30ms for 95th pct on typical project sample.
- Completion quality parity with hosted baseline on 3 canonical prompts.
- Plugin can switch to pinned model variant without needing full re-install.

Risks:
- Their security team balks at any ISP-hosted cache of source files; must ensure local-only indexing unless customer opts-in.
- Unknown infra cost for private Dedicated clusters if many seats stream concurrently — Optimize recommendations needed.

Stubs/links: Fireflies ff_93488_20260203, drive:/sales/proposals/kitebridge/redwood-proposal-v2.pdf, Jira RED-1124 (asked about KMS integration).

AE notes: keep demo narrow — focus on streaming latency, model pinning UX in plugin, and KMS design. Ask for a small internal pilot group (5 seats) and a telemetry contract for the pilot (anonymized metrics).
